FINAL PATHOLOGIC DIAGNOSIS: 
 
A. SENTINEL LYMPH NODE, LEFT AXILLA #939, EXCISION: 
There is no evidence of malignancy in two lymph nodes (0/2). (See note). 
NOTE: Immunostained slides for cytokeratin  REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID .3/Cam5.2, cytokeratin 7, and 
pankeratin were examined on tissue levels from each of 2 blocks. The frozen 
section diagnosis is confirmed. 
 
B. BREAST, LEFT, MASTECTOMY: 
- Atypical ductal hyperplasia and flat epithelial atypia with calcifications. 
- Fibrocystic changes with usual ductal hyperplasia, apocrine cysts and 
calcifications. Sclerosing adenosis. 
- Fibroadenoma (0.6cm ). 
- Healing biopsy site. 
 
C. BREAST, LEFT AREOLA/NIPPLE MARGIN, EXCISION: 
Lactiferous ducts and breast parenchyma. 
There is no evidence of malignancy. 
 
D. BREAST, RIGHT, MASTECTOMY: 
- Invasive lobular carcinoma. 
- Lobular neoplasia (lobular carcinoma in-situ). 
- Atypical ductal hyperplasia, focally severely atypical, with calcifications. 
- Fibrocystic changes with usual ductal hyperplasia, apocrine cysts and 
calcifications. 
- Intraductal papillomas. Sclerosing adenosis. 
- Two healing biopsy sites. 
- See table #1. See note #1. 
 
TABLE OF PATHOLOGICAL FINDINGS #1 
INVASIVE CARCINOMA RIGHT BREAST 
 
Tumor Size: Two nodules REMOVED_DATE x REMOVED_DATE x 1cm and REMOVED_DATE x REMOVED_DATE x 1.3cm (gross 
measurements), and several microscopic satellite nodules. 
Grade: 2. 
Lymphatic Vessel Invasion: Not identified. 
Blood Vessel Invasion: Not identified. 
Margin of Invasive Carcinoma: Invasive carcinoma extends to less than 0.1cm 
from the anterior margin of the specimen along a broad front (mass #1). 
Stains for Receptors: Requested on block  REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID . 
NOTE #1: The tumor cells are negative for E-cadherin by immunohistochemistry 
( REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID ). The tumor cells in the two nodules are morphologically similar. 
 
E. BREAST, RIGHT AREOLA-NIPPLE MARGIN, EXCISION: 
Lactiferous ducts. 
Cauterized intraductal proliferation. 
 
F. BREAST MARGIN, RIGHT ADDITIONAL ANTERIOR, EXCISION: 
Breast parenchyma and fat. 
There is no evidence of malignancy. 
 
G. LYMPH NODES, RIGHT AXILLARY CONTENTS, DISSECTION: 
Metastatic carcinoma in twenty-six of thirty-one lymph nodes (26/31). 
See table #2. See note #2. 
 
TABLE OF PATHOLOGIC FINDINGS #2 
SUMMARY OF RIGHT AXILLARY LYMPH NODES 
 
Total Number of Positive Lymph Nodes: 26. 
Total Number of Lymph Nodes Examined: 31. 
Number with metastases 0.02cm or less (isolated tumor cells): 0.

Number with metastases >0.2cm (macrometastases): 23. 
Extracapsular Extension: Marked 
Other Forms of Axillary Involvement: Soft tissue metastases. 
NOTE #2: The metastatic tumor cells appear more pleomorphic than in the breast 
tumors, with somewhat larger, more hyperchromatic and irregular nuclei. The 
results of immunohistochemical staining for estrogen receptor, progesterone 
receptor, and  REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID /neu protein expression and of fluorescence in-situ 
hybridization studies for  REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID /neu gene amplification will be reported in an 
addendum ( REMOVED_ACCESSION_ID ). 
 
H. BREAST MARGIN, RIGHT ADDITIONAL ANTERIOR TO MASS, EXCISION: 
Fibroadipose tissue. 
There is no evidence of malignancy.
